title: Data clock
description: A calendar clock that steps at a set rate (days, weeks, months, quarters or years) for data animations and time-lapses: a huge ghost year or date, a small date badge, or a translucent bottom band with the date, a progress slider and colour-ramp legends. Mono numerals, a tick per step for the sound design; reverse runs it backwards to sit over a reversed clip. Meant to sit over a map, a simulation or footage.

style.description: band (bottom HUD band: date, slider, legends), ghost (huge translucent stamp) or badge (small pill in the top corner).

end.description: Last date, same forms (empty: run at rate for the whole block).

step.description: What one step of the clock is.

rate.description: Steps per second (0: fit start..end into the block; with end set, the clock stops there).

format.description: Stamp: year (2006), month (Mar 2006, Q1 2006), date (2006 / 03 / 21), day (21 Mar 2006); auto picks by step.

reverse.description: Run from end back to start (for a reversed clip).

legends.description: Band legends, "Label=min..max@ramp" (ramps: thermal, ocean, aurora, heat, mono).

label.description: Small caption beside the stamp (a source, a place).
